It was first released in Japan on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on September 18, 2024. ==Blurb== ==Plot== A young girl is having a [[picnic]], eating [[sandwich]]es when she notices a group of {{p|Pawmi}}, {{p|Pawmo}}, and {{p|Pawmot}} dancing. She tries to grab them but fails. She asks her dad to grab them for her, and he agrees and brings the Pawmi to her. The girl hugs the Pawmi, making it happy, but notices the Pawmo and Pawmot and wants them too. The girl's dad brings over the Pawmot, struggling to carry it as it is slightly heavy. The girl pokes Pawmot's fur, and it releases electricity, shocking the dad in the process. The Pawmo, being the only one remaining, comes over to them on its own, and the girl's dad opens his arms wide to receive it. The Pawmo, however, jumps over the dad, landing in the girl's arms.
